items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: We had a write-up by every columnist except Walter Winchell, and I don't know why.

ctx.x: I more or less had a scrapbook, you know, of Sharky's band when we were at Nix in New York. We had a write-up by every columnist except Walter Winchell, and I don't know why. And I think we later did get one from Winchell, but I'm not sure of that.

Well to get back to the early days, you told me you played with this guy Stevens, Ernest Stevens, and you played some other little jobs. Do you remember the names of the other bands you worked with, Ernest Stevens?
